premise: One night Starfish sees shooting stars and thinks they are her cousins in the sky; Turtle tells her they are stars of the sky, and she is a star of the sea.
inspiration: The star-gazing tales of folk tradition (the child who wants to touch the stars), turned around: the little one is a star already.
lesson: You don't have to be far away to shine.

en-US.title: Starfish and the Shooting Stars
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] It was night on the beach, and the moon shone on the water. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish couldn't sleep. {starfish:face happy} She was looking up. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] A star went whizzing across the sky! Then another! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} Look! My cousins! They're starfish too! {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Turtle came crawling up, slowly. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] Those are stars of the sky, little one. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Far, far away. And you… you're a star of the sea. {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Starfish waved all five arms at the sky. Goodnight, cousins! {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal looked up from the rocks. {seal:face happy} [whispers] Make a wish, said Seal. So they did, all three. {seal:glow 0.3} [long pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Turtle tucked her head in. {seal:face sleeping} Seal closed her eyes. [softly] And Starfish, the littlest star of all, {starfish:live sleep hold} fell asleep under the stars of the sky.

es-ES.title: Estrella y las estrellas fugaces
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] Era de noche en la playa, y la luna brillaba sobre el agua. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella no podía dormir. {starfish:face happy} Estaba mirando hacia arriba. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] ¡Una estrella cruzó el cielo, zas! ¡Y otra! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} ¡Mirad! ¡Mis primas! ¡Son estrellas de mar, como yo! {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Tortuga llegó arrastrándose, despacito. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] Esas son estrellas del cielo, pequeña. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Están muy, muy lejos. Y tú… tú eres una estrella del mar. {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Estrella saludó al cielo con sus cinco brazos. ¡Buenas noches, primas! {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca levantó la vista desde las rocas. {seal:face happy} [whispers] Pedid un deseo, dijo Foca. Y eso hicieron, las tres. {seal:glow 0.3} [long pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Tortuga escondió la cabeza. {seal:face sleeping} Foca cerró los ojos. [softly] Y Estrella, la estrellita más pequeña de todas, {starfish:live sleep hold} se durmió bajo las estrellas del cielo.

ja-JP.title: ヒトデさんと ながれぼし
ja-JP.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s}[softly]うみべの夜。お月さまが、水の上をてらしています。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}ヒトデさんは、ねむれません。{starfish:face happy}空を、見上げていました。{canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s}[gasps]ほしが、すーっと空をはしった！ほら、もうひとつ！{starfish:face surprised}{starfish:live jump}「見て！わたしのいとこたち！みんな、ほしのかたちだもん！」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to starfish}ウミガメさんが、ゆっくり、はってきました。{starfish:go to turtle}{turtle:face happy}[warmly]「あれは、空のおほしさまよ、おちびさん。{turtle:live stretch-neck}ずっと、ずーっと、とおく。そして、あなたは…海のおほしさま」 {starfish:sparkle}{starfish:live wave}ヒトデさんは、五本のうでを、空にふりふり。「おやすみ、いとこたち！」 {seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}アザラシさんも、岩の上から見上げました。{seal:face happy}[whispers]「おねがいごと、しよう」 とアザラシさん。三人は、そっとおねがいしました。{seal:glow 0.3}[pause]{turtle:live peek hold}ウミガメさんは、くびをひっこめました。{seal:face sleeping}アザラシさんは、目をとじました。[softly]そして、いちばん小さなおほしさま、ヒトデさんも、{starfish:live sleep hold}空のおほしさまの下で、すやすやねむりました。

de-DE.title: Der Seestern und die Sternschnuppen
de-DE.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] Es war Nacht am Strand, und der Mond schien aufs Wasser. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Der Seestern konnte nicht schlafen. {starfish:face happy} Er schaute nach oben. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] Da sauste eine Sternschnuppe über den Himmel! Und noch eine! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} „Schaut mal! Meine Cousins! Das sind auch Sterne, genau wie ich!“ {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Die Meeresschildkröte kam langsam herangekrochen. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] „Das sind die Sterne vom Himmel, mein Kleiner. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Ganz, ganz weit weg. Und du… du bist ein Stern aus dem Meer. Ein Seestern!“ {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Der Seestern winkte mit allen fünf Armen zum Himmel hinauf. „Gute Nacht, ihr Cousins!“ {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Die Robbe schaute von den Felsen hoch. {seal:face happy} [whispers] „Wünscht euch was“, sagte die Robbe. Und das taten sie, alle drei. {seal:glow 0.3} [pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Die Schildkröte zog den Kopf ein. {seal:face sleeping} Die Robbe machte die Augen zu. [softly] Und der Seestern, der allerkleinste Stern von allen, {starfish:live sleep hold} schlief unter den Sternen am Himmel ein.

fr-FR.title: Étoile et les étoiles filantes
fr-FR.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] C’était la nuit sur la plage, et la lune brillait sur l’eau. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Étoile de mer n’arrivait pas à dormir. {starfish:face happy} Elle regardait en l’air. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] Une étoile a filé dans le ciel, fiou ! Et puis une autre ! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} « Regardez ! Mes cousines ! Ce sont des étoiles de mer, elles aussi ! » {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Tortue de mer est arrivée en rampant, tout doucement. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] « Ce sont des étoiles du ciel, ma petite. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Elles sont loin, très loin. Et toi… toi, tu es une étoile de la mer. » {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Étoile a salué le ciel de ses cinq bras. « Bonne nuit, mes cousines ! » {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Phoque a levé les yeux, depuis ses rochers. {seal:face happy} [whispers] « Faites un vœu », a dit Phoque. Alors ils ont fait un vœu, tous les trois. {seal:glow 0.3} [pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Tortue a rentré la tête. {seal:face sleeping} Phoque a fermé les yeux. [softly] Et Étoile, la plus petite étoile de toutes, {starfish:live sleep hold} s’est endormie sous les étoiles du ciel.

it-IT.title: Stella marina e le stelle cadenti
it-IT.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] Era notte sulla spiaggia, e la luna brillava sull'acqua. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Stella marina non riusciva a dormire. {starfish:face happy} Guardava in su. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] Una stella è sfrecciata nel cielo, zac! E poi un'altra! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} «Guardate! Le mie cugine! Sono stelle marine anche loro!» {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Tartaruga marina è arrivata strisciando, piano piano. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] «Quelle sono stelle del cielo, piccolina. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Lontane, lontane. E tu… tu sei una stella marina.» {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Stella ha salutato il cielo con tutte e cinque le braccia. «Buonanotte, cugine!» {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca ha alzato lo sguardo dagli scogli. {seal:face happy} [whispers] «Esprimete un desiderio», ha detto Foca. E così hanno fatto, tutte e tre. {seal:glow 0.3} [pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Tartaruga ha ritirato la testa. {seal:face sleeping} Foca ha chiuso gli occhi. [softly] E Stella, la stellina più piccola di tutte, {starfish:live sleep hold} si è addormentata sotto le stelle del cielo.

zh-TW.title: 海星和流星
zh-TW.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s}[softly]夜晚的海灘，月光灑在水面上。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星睡不著。{starfish:face happy}牠一直抬頭望著天空。{canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s}[gasps]一顆星星咻地劃過天空！又一顆！{starfish:face surprised}{starfish:live jump}「快看！是我的星星姊妹！她們跟我一樣，也是星星耶！」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to starfish}海龜慢慢地爬過來。{starfish:go to turtle}{turtle:face happy}[warmly]「小寶貝，那些是天上的星星，{turtle:live stretch-neck}離我們好遠好遠。而你呀……你是海裡的星星。」 {starfish:sparkle}{starfish:live wave}海星對著天空，揮揮五隻手臂。「晚安，星星姊妹！」 {seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹在岩石上抬起頭。{seal:face happy}[whispers]「許個願吧。」 海豹說。於是，牠們三個都許了願。{seal:glow 0.3}[pause]{turtle:live peek hold}海龜把頭縮進殼裡。{seal:face sleeping}海豹閉上眼睛。[softly]最小最小的那顆星星——海星，{starfish:live sleep hold}也在滿天的星星底下，睡著了。

zh-HK.title: 海星和流星
zh-HK.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s}[softly]夜晚的沙灘靜悄悄，月光灑在水面上。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星睡不着。{starfish:face happy}牠一直望着天空。{canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s}[gasps]一顆流星咻地劃過天空！又一顆！{starfish:face surprised}{starfish:live jump}「睇！係我嘅表姐妹！佢哋都係海星嚟㗎！」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to starfish}海龜慢慢地爬過來。{starfish:go to turtle}{turtle:face happy}[warmly]「嗰啲係天上嘅星星呀，乖。」 {turtle:live stretch-neck}「佢哋喺好遠好遠嘅地方。而你呢……你就係海星，住喺水入面嘅星星。」 {starfish:sparkle}{starfish:live wave}海星向着天空，揮動五隻手。「表姐妹，早唞！」 {seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹在岩石上抬起頭。{seal:face happy}[whispers]「許個願啦，」 海豹說。於是，牠們三個都許了願。{seal:glow 0.3}[pause]{turtle:live peek hold}海龜把頭縮進殼裏。{seal:face sleeping}海豹閉上了眼睛。[softly]而海星，最小最小的一顆星，{starfish:live sleep hold}就在滿天星星下，睡着了。
